background: UniCredit is Italy's second-largest bank and a leading lender in Germany, Austria and Central and Eastern Europe, funded by deposits across those markets, with a large stake in Commerzbank and a Russian subsidiary it has been winding down.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank A- stable, S&P A- positive and Moody's A3 after its upgrade on 25 Nov 2025, stable. Capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 14.2% is below the peer median and has fallen 2.1 points since 30 Jun 2024, and leverage of 5.2% is below the median too, down 0.3 points. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 141% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 124% at the median. The one flagged item, on 27 Jul 2026, is a possible EU sanctions exemption that could let it close a stalled deal tied to its Russian business, which would shrink an exposure rather than add one.
